keyVerseDR: "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased: hear ye him." (Mt 17:5)

level1.title: Jesus Shines
level1.story: Jesus took His friends up a high mountain. His face shone like the sun! God said, "This is My Son. Listen to Him!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you listen to Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me listen to You. Amen.

activity.title: On the high mountain
activity.intro: Draw Jesus shining on the mountain with His friends.
activity.prompt: Jesus shining bright as the sun on a high mountain, with Peter, James, and John

level2.title: The Transfiguration
level2.story: Jesus took Peter, James, and John up a high mountain. There He was transfigured: His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became white as light. Moses and Elijah appeared, talking with Him. A bright cloud covered them, and a voice said, "This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him." The disciples fell down in fear, but Jesus touched them and said, "Rise, and do not be afraid."
level2.keyLine: This is my beloved Son: hear ye him.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus show His glory to the disciples?
Where can you hear Jesus' voice?
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me listen to You. Amen.

activity.title: Mysteries of light
activity.intro: The Transfiguration is a Luminous Mystery of the Rosary. Match each mystery.
